rows.title_full:
AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING THE EXPANDED TERTIARY EDUCATION
EQUIVALENCY AND ACCREDITATION PROGRAM AND APPROPRIATING
FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Expanded Tertiary Education Equivalency And Accreditation Program ( E T E E A P ) Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to strengthen the academic equivalency and accreditation system at the college level, including the validation of the knowledge and expertise derived by senior high school graduates, postsecondary technical-vocational graduates, and college undergraduate students from relevant work experiences and high-level, non-formal training in order to harness their full potentials.
Defines Expanded Tertiary Education Equivalency and Accreditation Program (ETEEAP) as the alternative education program in the Philippines that allows working professionals who are either unable to finish their college education or were completely unable to advance into college for different reasons to earn a bachelor´s degree without going through the traditional schooling methods.
Mandates the Commission on Higher Education (CHED) to be the lead agency in the implementation of the provisions of this Act and to accredit colleges and universities that seek to offer the ETEEAP as part of their academic program.
rows.status: Republic Act RA12124 enacted on 2025-03-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING PUBLIC TELECOMMUNICATIONS ENTITIES AND INTERNET SERVICE PROVIDERS TO INSTITUTE A REFUND MECHANISM FOR SERVICE OUTAGES AND DISRUPTIONS, PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF
rows.title_short: Refund For Internet And Telecommunications Services Outages And Disruptions Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to provide regulations on internet and telecommunications services offered by public telecommunications entities (PTEs) and internet service providers (ISPs) to ensure that the interest and welfare of its people and the consuming public are protected and upheld.
Requires PTEs and ISPs to provide a refund credit on a pro-rated basis to a customer who was adversely affected by an internet service outage or interruption for an aggregate period of twenty-four (24) hours or more within a month, except when the reason for such outage is due to scheduled maintenance which should be notified 48 hours prior to the scheduled maintenance and should not exceed 48 hours in a month, a fortuitous event, or acts of third party or subscriber.
Provides penalties for the violation of this Act.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE ARCHIPELAGIC SEA LANES IN THE PHILIPPINE ARCHIPELAGIC WATERS, PRESCRIBING THE RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS OF FOREIGN SHIPS AND AIRCRAFT EXERCISING THE RIGHT OF ARCHIPELAGIC SEA LANES PASSAGE
rows.abstract:
Aims to minimize the routes and areas that shall be utilized and accessed by foreign vessels and foreign registered aircraft for the archipelagic sea lanes passage.
Defines Archipelagic Sea Lane Passage as “the exercise of the rights of navigation and overflight in the normal mode solely for the purpose of continuous, expeditious, and unobstructed transit between one part of the high seas or an exclusive economic zone (EEZ) and another part of the high seas or an EEZ.”
Provides the rights and obligations of foreign ships and aircraft when exercising the right of archipelagic sea lanes passage.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING THE MUSLIM FILIPINOS BETTER ACCESS TO SHARI´A COURTS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9997, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “NATIONAL COMMISSION ON MUSLIM FILIPINOS ACT OF 2009”
rows.title_short: Providing The Muslim Filipinos Better Access To Shari´a Courts, Amending For The Purpose Republic Act No. 9997, Otherwise Known As The “ National Commission On Muslim Filipinos Act Of 2009 ”
rows.abstract:
Seeks to allow the National Commission on Muslim Filipinos to act as a service provider for and in behalf of Muslim Filipinos to file and receive routine documents to the Shari´a Courts. 
Allows the creation of a digital platform in the pursuit of providing a paperless process on certain services of the Shari´a Courts.
Allows the Philippine Statistics Authority and the Commission to coordinate on the collection of statistical data for Muslim Filipinos in the national, regional, provincial, city, and municipal levels and directs them to prepare an annual report on the Muslim Filipino population which includes population, annual births, marriages, and deaths.

rows.author: H057;F057;D013;K092;K129;K078;J064;K002;K005;K045;E003;K013;
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING A CLIMATE CHANGE EMERGENCY AND ENHANCING RESILIENCY AND ADAPTABILITY TO THE EFFECTS OF CLIMATE CHANGE
rows.abstract:
Aims to develop and implement solutions to adapt and mitigate the adverse impacts of climate change for the protection and preservation of people´s lives, livelihoods, and the environment.
Declares the country in a state of climate emergency that stresses the need for the government to devise measures to stop human-caused global warming, limit its effects, and to mobilize funds for climate mitigation efforts. 
Pools different government agencies and private entities to immediately and efficiently coordinate in taking practicable measures to preserve and protect the environment.
Declares a Climate Change Resiliency and Adaptability Summit to be held on the second week of September of every year which aims to collaborate efforts of various concerned agencies in environment preservation and protection.
